subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing name should OpenClaw use for the existing `google-vertex` provider now that Google documents Vertex AI name changes under Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform?
rationale: Source inspection confirms stale visible copy, but the requested wording differs from the official name-change page and changing provider ids would be compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Use Gemini Enterprise wording
options.body: Update labels/docs to `Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)` or similar while keeping all `google-vertex` ids stable.

options.title: Keep Vertex AI wording
options.body: Leave the current `Google Vertex AI` label until Google SDK/API naming and OpenClaw docs intentionally move together.

options.title: Use Google Enterprise AI wording
options.body: Adopt the reporter's shorter wording only if maintainers want OpenClaw's label to differ from the checked Google Cloud name-change table.

recommendation.title: Use Gemini Enterprise wording
recommendation.body: Update labels/docs to `Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)` or similar while keeping all `google-vertex` ids stable.

likelyOwner.reason: The open discussion points to this handle for UI/UX/docs labeling direction, which is the unresolved decision before implementation.
